definitions.explanation: Describes a person who carefully calculates personal advantage in everything they do. Almost always negative, implying excessive self-interest or manipulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計算高|けいさんだか}い。
{計算高|けいさんだか}い⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{損|そん}→損：03325_son⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{絶対|ぜったい}→絶対：00435_zettai⟧にしない。
examples.english: Being calculating, she never does anything that doesn't benefit her.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧そう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{計算高|けいさんだか}くて⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧しか⟦{考|かんが}えていない→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: He looks kind, but he's actually calculating and only thinks about his own interests.

notes:
USAGE:
{計算高|けいさんだか}い is almost always negative, suggesting someone who weighs every action in terms of personal gain. Unlike ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ (clever) or ⟦{頭|あたま}がいい→頭がいい：20316_atamagaii⟧ (smart), which are positive, {計算高|けいさんだか}い implies a cold, self-serving shrewdness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {計算高|けいさんだか}い⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a calculating person)
- {計算高|けいさんだか}い⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧ (a calculating personality)
- {計算高|けいさんだか}く⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to act calculatingly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{狡|ずる}い→狡い：03929_zurui⟧ (sly, unfair) is more bluntly negative. ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}がない→抜け目がない：28319_nukemeganai⟧ (shrewd, missing nothing) can be slightly more neutral or even admiring.
